checks.description: the cluster is ACTIVE on Kubernetes 1.37
checks.because: Terraform created one EKS Auto Mode cluster at the pinned minor version.

checks.description: Kueue 0.20.7, Kubeflow Trainer 2.4.0, JobSet, LeaderWorkerSet, KEDA, agentgateway and the endpoint picker are all running
checks.because: Each is installed by Terraform from a pinned chart version. The controllers' own image tags are the evidence.

checks.description: every pod in the cluster is running
checks.because: Helm waited for each release to be ready before Terraform moved on.

checks.description: there is one GPU pool per workload family, each tainted so only Kueue-admitted pods can use it
checks.because: The pools are Auto Mode NodePools with a GPU taint. A pod gets the toleration only through its Kueue ResourceFlavor.

checks.description: four queues share one cohort: notebooks, training, serving and batch
checks.because: Terraform creates one ClusterQueue per family, all naming the cohort gpu-fleet, so idle quota can be borrowed.

checks.description: batch has no GPU of its own and serving may lend at most one of its two
checks.because: Batch work runs only on what serving is not using, and serving keeps a guaranteed floor of one GPU.

checks.description: the training runtime, the inference gateway, its route, the pool and the autoscaler exist
checks.because: Each is created by Terraform; none is created by a user.

checks.description: no GPU capacity is bought while nothing is queued
checks.because: The GPU pools start empty. A node is bought only when an admitted pod needs it. (EC2 does not list Auto Mode's instances to the account, so the NodeClaims, which are the pools' own record of every machine, are the evidence.)
